_comment: 82-0-challenge SEO queue. The WEEKLY job builds every pending entry in one batch (file order = priority order), not one per day.
_usage: Run /next-seo-page with cwd /Users/mila/Code/82-0-challenge. It processes the whole pending list.
_source: Keywords come from Google Trends related-query exports dropped into product-dofollow-files/82-0-challenge/trends-*-YYYY-MM-DD.csv. Rebuild the queue from the newest export; if there is no newer export than last run, STOP and build nothing.
_rules: Collapse word-order variants into ONE page. '82-0 nba' / 'nba 82-0' / '82-0 game nba' are one intent. Building a page per variant just makes them compete.

Only build CONTENT pages that reuse an existing FILTERS id from src/lib/engine (classic, cap, noMvps, oneFranchise, oneDecade, randomEra, hard, eraMode, lebron). A keyword implying NEW game rules — a specific player, a new constraint — needs a FILTERS entry with its own pool logic and player data. That is a code change: SKIP it and report it for manual work.
Every page needs BOTH src/app/<slug>/page.js and src/app/[lang]/<slug>/page.js. Missing the second one loses all seven non-English locales.
Do not hand-edit next-sitemap.config.js — it scans src/app for directories containing page.js.
Bare terms with no 82-0 in them (nba, basketball, wordle, retro bowl) are NOT this site's keywords. Trends returns them as co-searches. Skip them.
Content must be specific and factual — real records (73-9, 72-10, 33-game streak), real season lengths. No invented statistics.
